exams.name: ICAgile Certified Expert – Agile Coaching
exams.blurb: Expert-level assessment of demonstrated agile coaching competence through evidence submission and panel evaluation.

exams.name: ICAgile Certified Professional – Agile Coaching
exams.blurb: Learning-outcome certification covering coaching stance, mentoring, professional coaching skills and team development.

exams.name: ICAgile Certified Professional – Agile Fundamentals

exams.name: ICAgile Certified Professional – Agile Programming

exams.name: ICAgile Certified Professional – Agile Team Facilitation
exams.blurb: Certification covering facilitation stance, meeting design, conflict handling and collaborative decision-making for agile teams.

exams.name: MSP Foundation

exams.name: MSP Practitioner

exams.name: PRINCE2 Agile Foundation

exams.name: PRINCE2 Agile Practitioner

exams.name: PRINCE2 Practitioner

exams.name: SHRM Certified Professional

exams.name: SHRM Workplace Investigations Specialty Credential

exams.name: IPMA Level B Certified Senior Project Manager

exams.name: IPMA Level C Certified Project Manager
exams.blurb: Certification for managers of moderately complex projects, combining written examination with competence evidence review.

exams.name: IPMA Level D Certified Project Management Associate

exams.name: Retirement Plans Associate
